name: nose-graft-film
description: D235's graft film: grafted nose, not evolved. D178's ten founders (rounds/nursery/pools/410a70db44a4b20a.tsv), each with a nose grafted by NoseGraft (Evosim.Nursery --graft-nose): a box of 0.1 m2, three times as long as wide, standing on the root's top face toward its front, on a fixed joint, every leaf-smell link moved onto it with weights summed. Swum as the bench swims a pool, every brain as written, four to a tank (4, 4 and 2), for 300 s in leaf-direction-patches-s2-w5's patchy tank and its world, the round-60 world, whose config here, 3a95d053dd97082d, is 9fa947462638667c's (e80c201e54b3963f on integration-1's format) less mouth.killSwallowsBody, which was false and which branch nose's reader does not have, with the nose appended to the cell-type table at its defaults and nothing else changed: noise from the area law, the facing intake off. Two episodes, under the body's own brain and with the leaf smell knocked out. A film and nothing scored: the bodies were bred to whole-body smell, not to a nose, and a knockout that matters says only that the moved links still steer. The pool, 2a101bfbce346e65, is what --graft-nose wrote from 410a70db44a4b20a.
